independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox; independent reproduction is open.

index.reading: A key has to be injective on the distinction the policy depends on. If every family either collides kinds that need different policies or degenerates to one key per kind, the features do not CONTAIN that distinction and no bucketing of them can supply it. The repair is a new observable, not a finer grid.

unbound_name_retraction.what_that_number_now_means: the number of descriptions still alive after one demonstration -- a measure of REDUNDANCY in the language, not of ambiguity and not of a second grammar. It must no longer be quoted as the cost of identifying a step.

vocabulary_repair_cost.reading: absence removes the separation obstruction but not the enumeration bound, so the obstacle moves from representation to combinatorics

three_blockers_as_one_verified_index.identifiability: no split from one trace; chosen causal observation splits survivors
three_blockers_as_one_verified_index.synthesis_verification_asymmetry: replay handles repeated syntax; grounded proposal plus execution verifier and frame handle new work
three_blockers_as_one_verified_index.vocabulary_insufficiency: index key does not contain the policy-relevant observable; repetition reports the same fact vector
